A-INSPECT.assumption: Only M-1158 has a payout signal; 50-90% chance the inspection finds and fixes the paytable; recovers its $/day shortfall

A-WAYFINDING.assumption: Back Forty only: signs lift entries 0-10%; play tracks entries ~1:1 (walkway closure)

A-MOVE-MACHINE.assumption: Only 3 free slots in busier zones (2 Pit, 1 Hotel); 30-80% of the gain is displaced play

A-PROMO.assumption: 3-day weekend; per-day lift from this property's two past promotions, noise from placebo windows, 50-100% for summer

A-TECH-SHIFT.assumption: Cuts 10-30% of downtime's lost theo (itself an upper bound)

A-PREVENTIVE.assumption: Ridgeline sweep cuts 0-50% of Ridgeline downtime

A-REPLACE-LEASE.assumption: Same slot, new title: the only real swap moved theo/h by +$0.39

A-REPLACE-BUY.assumption: As lease, with a longer lead time

A-COMP-PILOT.assumption: Information only in July (decides whether to keep the May 1 point price)

A-COMP-CHANGE.assumption: Information only; cannot run with the pilot

A-MOVE-BANK.assumption: Not feasible: no zone has 7 free slots, so it is excluded from the search
